status: All43 remaining note positions reinspected;12 exact note retirements independently approved and applied
scope: Fresh word and exact-glyph examination of every remaining First and Second Maccabees note; this does not claim a new whole-book author comparison. The separately authorized2MA14:4 restored consonant remains visibly disclosed.
method: Extract original embedded scan images, locate unchanged prior word pixels in those source pages, inspect bounded native crops and5x/15x nearest-neighbor enlargements, and obtain root independent confirmation before applying any text or note change. Source geometry alone determines points or false positives. No OCR, grammar, expected spelling, smoothing, thresholding, sharpening, generated pixels or another translation supplies text.
